QuestInfo.name: Chemical Seal
QuestInfo.0: Go to #b#p3001100##k and talk to her about the seal ritual #rTreglow#k performed.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p3001100##k tells you to go see #b#p3001104##k and help him remove the chemical seal.
QuestInfo.2: You met up with #b#p3001104##k. What will he make you do?
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 207,600
Can proceed to the Seal Remover quest

0.0: Hmm... as expected, #rTreglow#k's locks are sealed with some very high-level chemistry.
0.1: Looks like we won't be able to resolve this with brute force or magic. Hmm, I need some live samples.
0.2: You know, #bGrandis's Shadowdealers#k are pretty well-versed in chemicals. Perhaps they could be of some service.
0.3: Fortunately, #rTreglow#k was an important figure in the old days. There should be a good bit of documentation his research and breakthroughs. I took the liberty of contacting #b#p3001104##k.
0.4: You go and help #b#p3001104##k. He and his ilk seem to know their way around a cylindrical flask or two.

yes.0: Hurry over to #b#p3001104##k and see what he knows.

no.0: We can't reach Treglow unless we remove that seal.

1.0: Ah, #b#p3001100##k told me she'd be assigning someone to visit me. I'm sure you know how super-capable I am by now.
1.1: #b#p3001100##k and I have been sharing research on this Treglow fellow. Allow me to expedite that process and get right back to you, okay?
